items.source_caption: Every ground floor apartment in Hoboken, NJ was a total loss. This apartment across the street from Fiore's Deli on Adams Street still has water up to the door knobs. The man who lives here almost drowned. He was inside his apartment when a storm surge of 2-feet above street level swept into this neighborhood. The flood waters rushing into his apartment came so fast, and were so strong, that they prevented him from opening his door from the inside. His upstairs neighbors jumped into the flood waters, pried open his door and saved his life. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/46704884@N03/8149344513 Uploader: https://www.flickr.com/photos/accarrino/
